summary: Iteration 26 — FULL PASS. Backend: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_voice.py + test_family_nudge.py + test_family_weekly_push.py → 9/9 GREEN in 2.81s. POST /api/ask/stream with 'What does it mean when Apollo growls?' returns SSE (text/event-stream) with a Higgins-voice reply that (a) refers to Apollo in the third person ('he'), (b) uses courteous English tone ('I would suggest…', 'Do keep your wits about you'), and (c) contains no 'sir'/'madam'. Frontend web 390x844 across fresh contexts. Home hero: 'Apollo is patrolling' + meaning 'On the lookout. All is well within the checks Apollo can currently see.'; hero-hear-higgins button labelled 'Hear Higgins' → tap → label becomes 'Stop' with network POST /api/voice/speak → 200 application/json + GET /api/voice/<key>.mp3 → 200 audio/mpeg; second tap → back to 'Hear Higgins'. Tab bar shows testID tab-ask with label 'Higgins'. Ask screen: ask-header 'Ask Higgins', ask-empty text mentions 'Higgins is Apollo's handler'. Tapped ask-suggestion-0 → SSE POST /api/ask/stream 200 text/event-stream → ask-msg-apollo streamed the growl explanation in Higgins voice → an ask-hear-<id> button rendered labelled 'Hear Higgins' → tap → label 'Stop' + POST /api/voice/speak 200 + audio mp3 fetched. NO 'Ask Apollo' string found on Home, Ask, Settings, Privacy, or Family. Settings: settings-higgins card + settings-higgins-auto switch + settings-higgins-sample button ('Hear a sample' → 'Stop' during playback); settings-about text = 'Apollo is a brand of Harmony Wellness Group. Apollo is the guard dog; Higgins is his handler and the voice you hear. Australia-first, privacy-first — no account, no tracking.'; localStorage key 'apollo.voice.auto' persists the toggle across reload. Privacy disclosure (/privacy-disclosure): includes 'Apollo is a brand of Harmony Wellness Group', a row 'The sentence Higgins reads aloud', and 'Ask Higgins' wording (no 'Ask Apollo'). Check flows: /check?url=http://203.0.113.9/update/login → check-result-state pill 'Apollo is growling' + compact check-hear-higgins speaker button; tapping fires POST /api/voice/speak (200) + GET /api/voice/<h>.mp3 (200 audio/mpeg). With settings-higgins-auto ON, /check?url=http://testsafebrowsing.appspot.com/s/phishing.html → check-result-state 'Apollo is barking' AND POST /api/voice/speak fires automatically (verified in network log) without any user tap → mp3 fetched 200. Family weekly: paired via API using localStorage 'apollo.securecore.mock.identity' deviceId (note: value is double-JSON-encoded → JSON.parse twice to reach .deviceId): protected paired as owner_name='Mum' → code → guardian /api/family/link → {linked:true, owner_name:'Mum'}. /family shows testIDs family-weekly-preview ('Preview Sunday's') and family-weekly-preview-nudge ('Preview Tuesday's'); tapping Tuesday → family-weekly-preview-text starts EXACTLY with "Higgins: a hello for Mum, perhaps? — You haven't checked in with Mum since Sunday."; tapping Sunday → text starts EXACTLY with "Higgins: your Sunday check-in — A quiet week for Mum. Nothing came up that needed a look." No console errors observed during any of the flows. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) found in package.json / app.json.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py:1855 & 1869 — FastAPI on_event('startup')/on_event('shutdown') are deprecated in favour of lifespan handlers. Not in scope for this iteration but worth migrating soon to keep the test log clean of PendingDeprecationWarnings.

Higgins auto-read pref lives at localStorage key 'apollo.voice.auto' (verified in the browser after toggling settings-higgins-auto). Naming is fine but a doc-comment near the switch reading the key would help future maintainers — the on-disk name doesn't include the word 'higgins' while the testID does.

family-weekly-preview-text is a single Text node that concatenates the title, an em-dash and the body. Reading via textContent works; consider splitting into two <Text> children for accessibility (screen readers pause on the em-dash) — Higgins' voice would flow more naturally.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all required testIDs and copy strings verified across Home hero, Ask (Higgins), Settings, Privacy disclosure, Check (growling + auto-play barking) and Family weekly (Sunday + Tuesday)
